name: Manaweave Robe
label: Quest
description: In Stormwind, Wynne Larson presents the Manaweave Robe as a proud showcase for her family’s shop. She has woven the enchanted garment from fine materials…
intro: In Stormwind, Wynne Larson presents the Manaweave Robe as a proud showcase for her family’s shop. She has woven the enchanted garment from fine materials for a commission that is now complete.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your robe. It's one of my best made yet! Wear it with pride, and when people ask... Tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
